intro.summary: St. Juan Diego, an Indigenous Mexican convert, is honored for his faith and witness connected with Our Lady of Guadalupe.

blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Dear St Juan Diego, pray for me as I recall the comforting words that Our Lady of Guadalupe spoke to you: Hear me and understand well, my littlest son, that nothing should frighten or grieve you. Let not your heart be disturbed. Do not fear any sickness or anguish. Am I not here, who is your Mother? Are you not under my protection? Am I not your health? Are you not happily within my mantle? What else do you wish? Do not grieve nor be disturbed by anything. O St Juan Diego, Our Lady of Guadalupe chose you as her faithful messenger. You demonstrated your complete faith in her, and to this day it is visible in the miraculous image the Virgin left upon your tilma. Intercede for me, I pray, that I might have your childlike trust in the Mother of God, and that my heart might respond to her maternal promptings. Especially, I ask for

Through such simple confidence, obedience, and love, may I join you one day in sharing everlasting joy, where our heavenly Mother reigns in the glory of Her Son. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St Juan Diego, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
